title: Telemetry dispatch resume ack
description: contract_revision: 1 (new schema — dispatch-liveness convention). An immediate acknowledgement a resumed dispatch may emit ('received, working on X') before starting a long task, giving a caller instant liveness confirmation on a resume path without waiting for the first heartbeat or the terminal write. References the SAME dispatch_id the original telemetry-dispatch-record.json in_flight write used — a resume is a continuation of an existing dispatch, not a new one, so this record does not mint its own dispatch identity. Schema + emitter only: this record describes WHAT a resumed agent may emit, never HOW or WHEN a resume is delivered to a running vs completed process — that delivery mechanism lives entirely in whatever harness/transport a deployment uses to resume a dispatch, outside loadout's tree (CLAUDE.md hard rule 2; see docs/integration.md's dispatch-liveness section for the explicit out-of-scope note). additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist.

dispatch_id.description: The dispatch being resumed — matches the dispatch_id of the original telemetry-dispatch-record.json in_flight write. Shape is caller-defined, same convention as the dispatch-record schema.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the resumed dispatch emitted this ack.

resuming.description: Optional short, non-prose description of what the resumed dispatch is about to work on (e.g. "continuing PR #332 fix"). Purely descriptive — no schema-enforced vocabulary, a consumer treats it as opaque display text.
